findings: The workflow remains failed: official job conclusions are two successes and three failures. Browser runner contracts and release-site success are metadata observations only.

All three Chrome/Firefox/Edge production jobs failed while building the optimized original native fixture with cargo build --release --locked. Each official failed job log reports E0433 at crates/sdk/src/webrtc_host.rs:142:5: production log::info! cannot resolve crate log.

The old exact-source SDK manifest placed log = =0.4.34 only in dev-dependencies. This fails when SDK is compiled as the fixture production library. The separately committed b28a879 keeps the exact same version, moves it to existing native target dependencies and adds the SDK log edge to the existing fixture lock. No local lock generation or dependency install is claimed.

Native fixture build failure preceded browser selection/extraction and the actual video/audio/input/files/cleanup step; those steps are skipped in all three jobs. This run contains no new Firefox execution outcome and no ICE/403 root-cause conclusion.

The original f24 Firefox actual runtime failure, including first native signal POST204 then POST403 and the unchanged original timeout, remains recorded in web-firefox-f24b79f.json. Its failure is not replaced by this later compilation failure or by successful Web-site build metadata.
